Text:
# BITE WOUNDS WITH STREPTOCOCCI

Infection but no arthritis - 10 days joint involved - 14-21 days

---

References:

- Sanford keyword: Bites
- Mandell chapter: Cellulitis and subcutaneous tissue infections
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC BITE WNDS STREPTOCOCCI
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment

Penicillin G 4 MU IV q4h ($) [R] < Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h ($) [R] < OR >
Cephalexin 500 mg PO q6h ($) [R] < OR >
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO q6h ($) [DI]
Alternative for penicillin allergic patients:
Clindamycin 300 mg PO q6h ($) [H,O]

## Outpatient

### Treatment for infection without joint involvement

Treat for 10 days.
Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID ($) [R] < OR >
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO QID ($0.48/day) [DI]

### Alternative for beta-lactam allergy:

[Assess Beta-lactam allergy prior to ordering alternative](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Linezolid 600 mg PO BID for 10 days ($) [DI,O]

### Treatment for infection with joint involvement

Treat for 14 to 21 days.
Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID ($) [R] < OR >
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO QID ($) [DI]

### Alternative for beta-lactam allergy:

[Assess Beta-lactam allergy prior to ordering alternative](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Linezolid 600 mg PO q12h ($) [DI,O] for 14 days

*Local guidance (St. Cloud CDSS, Outpatient):*
Clindamycin 300 mg PO QID for 10 days ($) [H,O]
Clindamycin 300 mg PO QID for 14 days ($) [H,O]

## ER/UC

### Treatment for infection without joint involvement

Treat for 10 days.
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO BID x10days ($) [R]
<OR>
Cefazolin 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [R]
Alternative for beta-lactam allergy:
Clindamycin 300 mg PO QID for 10 days ($) [H,O]

### Treatment for infection with joint involvement

Treat for 14 to 21 days.
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h ($) [R] for 14 days
<OR>
Cefazolin 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [R]
Alternative for beta-lactam allergy:
Clindamycin 300 mg PO QID for 14 days ($) [H,O]
